title: Coast Guard Rescues Kayaker in Florida Bay Near Everglades National Park
description: A Coast Guard Air Station Miami MH-65 Dolphin helicopter crew recues a kayaker Friday, March 10, 2017 in Florida Bay near Everglades National Park. The kayaker was participating in the WaterTribe kayaking challenge and capsized in Florida Bay and notified the Coast Guard with a personal locating beacon.
